title: Use versioned API routing at the gateway
summary: Route client traffic through a versioned gateway layer to support safe API evolution and compatibility.

content.decision: Adopt versioned routing (for example, /api/v1, /api/v2) and centralize route mapping in the gateway.
content.rationale: Allows incremental backend changes without breaking existing clients and keeps routing policy in one place.
content.trade_offs: Adds gateway configuration overhead and requires route lifecycle management during migrations.
